description: Uploads site files and returns a live HTTPS link (name.dropthehassle.app) and a claim link (claim_url). Works without an account. Files are sent inline as path, content and encoding (utf8 or base64). This server cannot read a folder on the caller's computer. The published files are index.html at the top, or the built folder dist/, build/, out/, _site/, .output/public or docs/. With an account, site names the site to update and name is omitted; without site the oldest reserved address on the account is filled. Does not buy a name. Size limits: 25 MB and 1,000 files before the site is claimed, 100 MB and 5,000 files when signed in.

email.description: The email address the claim link is sent to. Used for that link and up to 3 reminders about this site. Required when no account is connected.

files.description: Site files sent inline. Each item has path, content, and encoding utf8 or base64. node_modules, .git and hidden files are not part of the site. .well-known is allowed.

content.description: File contents. UTF-8 text, or standard base64 when encoding is base64.

path.description: Relative path, for example index.html or css/site.css.

name.description: Address label, for example "lisas-bakery" for lisas-bakery.dropthehassle.app. Used when creating a site. Works with no account token.

site.description: Optional site address to update, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app. Absent fills the oldest reserved address on the account.

slug.description: Same as name. Older clients send this.

name: deploy_site
title: Deploy site
